full_judgment: 10. We note from the judgement of the trial Court that upon elaborate discussion of the facts and circumstances and the evidence on record it was found that the predecessor of the plaintiffs obtained title to the suit land through probate of the Will executed by the original owner of the land, namely Satish Mohon Roy. It was observed by the trial Court that the suit property was recorded in the name of Purna Shashi Dasya, daughter of Satish Mohon Roy, in the S.A. Khatian and neither the defendants nor the predecessor of the defendants namely Narayan Chandra Roy raised any question regarding the S.A. Khatian. It was further observed that neither Satish Mohon Roy nor any of his heirs challenged the Will executed by Satish Mohon Roy. It was also observed that the name of Puma Shashi Dasya was recorded in R.S. Khatian No. 2529 and on her behalf her husband Subol Chandra Das transferred the suit land by way of 5 separate deeds in the year 1981 in favour of the plaintiffs, who thereafter mutated their names in respect of the suit land. The trial Court concluded that Narayan Chandra Roy therefore had no title to transfer by way of the disputed deeds dated 1996 and 1998. Accordingly, the trial Court decided that the plaintiffs were able to prove their title in the suit property and decreed the 5 disputed deeds detailed in schedule that to the plaint as void.
